Before you offer, read the strata documents: the depreciation report, meeting minutes, bylaws and fees.

items.t: North Delta real estate market stats

faq.q: What is the benchmark price of a townhome in North Delta?
faq.a: The Fraser Valley Real Estate Board MLS® Home Price Index benchmark for townhomes in North Delta was $845,600 in September 2026, a modelled price for a typical home and not an average of sales.

faq.q: Did townhome prices fall in North Delta?
faq.a: Over the past year the benchmark fell 4.7%. Over three months it fell 2.7%. A change under 1.5% is not described as a rise or fall.

faq.q: Is North Delta a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026 houses in North Delta had a sales ratio of 11%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market, and condos and townhomes 11%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many townhomes are for sale in North Delta?
faq.a: The listing feed on this page shows what is active now, and the number changes daily. Ask Jared and he will send you the townhomes in North Delta that match what you want.

faq.q: Can Jared alert me when townhomes come up in North Delta?
faq.a: Yes. Tell him the area, price range and must-haves and he will alert you the day a match is listed.

faq.q: Where can I see all North Delta homes?
faq.a: The North Delta homes for sale page covers every home type, and the North Delta market stats page has the monthly figures.
Jared is a REALTOR® and Personal Real Estate Corporation with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, working across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. You can call or text him at 604-928-1361.
